items.label: STABLE & STURDY
items.value: For the growth of plants in pots, each single indoor plant stakes for potted plants can be easily inserted into the pots to provide strong growth without disturbing the plants while reducing damage to the roots

items.label: FOR BOTH INDOOR AND OUTDOOR PLANTS
items.value: Unlike normal metal trellis for climbing plants indoor on the market, PERSZEN plant accessories indoor made of plastic won't fade, rust or rot even under sunlight and rain. The high-quality material won't also leave harmful residue in the pots

items.label: SUITABLE FOR DIFFERENT PEOPLE
items.value: Whether you are only an normal gardening enthusiast or a professional gardener, the adjustable height and stackable design of plant poles for climbing plants allows you to adjust the height of climbing plant support according to the different heights of plants

items.label: SUITABLE PLANTS TYPES
items.value: Please NOTE that this plastic indoor plant accessories can not be used for large plants, but can be used for climbing plants like succulents, potted flowers such as roses, sunflowers, tulips, orchids, petunias and other small, medium-sized plants
